emma_cs: Heads up — Riverstone org (acct org_6742) usage dropped ~42% last week. Renewal in ~42 days. New Head of Data joined and looks like they're running a competitive eval. Need triage and quick playbook. :warning:
ops_bot: automated alert - org org_6742 — weekly token volume delta: -42% (threshold -30%) — created 1719801240
raj_ae: ack. any known trigger? price? perf? product fit?
emma_cs: initial digging — no billing spikes, top 3 routes show steep drop in summarize and semantic-search. Their seat activity also down. Quick snapshot: ```week, total_tokens
2026-03-02, 1,240,000
2026-03-09, 980,000
2026-03-16, 718,000```
emma_cs: they have an upcoming exec review — Jordan Price (Head of Data) joined 2 weeks ago. Notes from last call: evaluating NovaAI and a self-host option.
sarah_se: thanks. I'll run a latency + error-rate check for last 30 days, want to rule out perf regressions. if model swapped to smaller variant we should catch it.
miguel_csm: I'll request an intro call with Jordan. Suggested framing: "concise health review + demo of recent efficiency wins". Can do Tue/Wed next week. :calendar:
raj_ae: can we pull model-level traffic? want to see if they switched to a cheaper model or reduced prompt lengths. Also need any contract levers (discounts/entitlements) on renewal.
emma_cs: model breakdown (last 3 weeks): ```model,tokens
redwood-l1,820000
redwood-lite,260000
open-small,20000 (appeared in last week)```
emma_cs: looks like they started routing some traffic to open-small last week — possible experiment.
sarah_se: I'll prioritize: 1) perf checks 2) prompt-change diff 3) run a short eval comparing redwood-l1 vs open-small on their top 5 prompts.
miguel_csm: i'll ask for permission to join their internal eval session and offer a quick cost/latency comparison pack. propose 30m slot + 1-pager.
raj_ae: who owns collateral? i'll draft an exec-facing 1-pager highlighting SLA, cost delta, and retention play. emma, can you give me top 3 business workflows we should emphasize?
emma_cs: Top workflows: (1) customer support summarization, (2) contract search/semantic match, (3) auto triage suggestions for agents. All are latency-sensitive.
miguel_csm: propose this action list: - schedule sync w/ Jordan (miguel) - perf + prompt audit (sarah) - exec 1-pager + benchmark (raj) - outreach note w/ recommended next steps (emma). I'll schedule slots and loop in product if needed.
ops_bot: created task in CS tracker: CS-7892 "Riverstone renewal triage" assigned miguel_csm, due 7 days
raj_ae: leaving a quick ask — if we confirm they're running NovaAI pilot, can someone pull cost-per-1000-token parity and recent latency numbers for NovaAI vs our L1? i'll add to slide.
sarah_se: i'll pull latency quantiles and tail p95. expect results in ~24 hrs.

miguel_csm: booked: Tue 2026-03-24 10:00-10:30 PT — <https://cal.com/riverstone/renewal-triage> — tentative, shared with Jordan. I'll add agenda and ask for their goal of the eval.
raj_ae: I'll start the 1-pager draft and share a link.
sarah_se: noted, will post perf snippets once checks finish.
emma_cs: thanks team. priority = keep them from switching before our joint eval. :thumbsup:
